messages:
anna: Trying the Python quickstart from a customer's laptop. First call hangs for ~30s then client returns 'unauthorized' but curl shows a billing_required JSON. Very confusing for a first-time dev.
peter: Are you on a corp network or using any HTTP proxy? That sequence sounds like a transport-layer issue first then a server-side policy after retry.
anna: It's a hotel Wi-Fi + their captive portal (ugh). I did a raw curl and got back a portal HTML before any JSON. After completing the portal, curl to the endpoint returns {"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace needs billing setup"}. The sample app just shows "401 unauthorized".
sam: Captive portals often intercept TLS and return HTML which breaks the SDK handshake and sometimes leads the client lib to classify as auth error. We should surface the raw transport response in quickstart logs. Right now our SDK collapses different transport errors into a single auth-ish error.
maria: Also noticing SDK parity gap: Node quickstart surfaced a clearer 402 earlier, but Python prints a generic requests.exceptions.HTTPError with not much context. We should align messages across SDKs and include the raw response body when available.
anna: Repro steps:
1) Connect to captive wifi (no internet until portal)
2) Run python sample.py with REDWOOD_KEY set
3) sample logs: "failed to create session: unauthorized" -> after portal accepted, curl shows billing_required
This made the user think their API key was revoked.
sam: Action items: 1) add a quickstart troubleshooting subsection called "captive portals / intercepting proxies" with examples of how to verify (curl -I, wget), 2) change SDK to log transport response bodies on non-2xx for first-call flows, and 3) normalize billing error codes to 402/402-like with friendly message pointing to org billing console.
peter: I'll PR a tiny README update with the captive portal note + a minimal curl snippet to validate connectivity. maria, can you open a DEVEX issue to track SDK parity logging across Python/Node/Go?
maria: Filed DEVEX-1150 "sdk: unify first-call transport logging and clear billing error surfacing" and assigned to sam + eng-infra.
devex-bot: new issue created: DEVEX-1150 "sdk: unify first-call transport logging and clear billing error surfacing"  assigned to sam
anna: Thanks. For now I'll add a short line in our onboarding checklist: "If your first call errors, check for captive portal/proxy before rotating keys". Saves support tickets. :+1:
